notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). No StrategyWiki page under "Outriders" or "OUTRIDERS". outriders.fandom.com answers the API under "Outriders", with about 69 linked pages, mostly cast members plus system pages such as "Classes", "Expeditions", "World Tier", "Challenge Tiers" and "Worldslayer"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema calls the app "Madness" (an internal codename); app 680420 is "OUTRIDERS". 9 of 52 Steam achievements are hidden; all have high unlock rates (51 to 91%) and read like story beats, so they sit in the main story chapter. The last eight achievements (Molten Depths, the Marshal's Complex, Tarya Gratar, the Arbiters, "Embrace the Madness" and Apocalypse Tier 25) have low unlock rates (3 to 13%) and get their own chapter; RAWG lists "Outriders Worldslayer" (2022-06-28) as a separate entry and Fandom links a "Worldslayer" page, so they may belong to that expansion, but the data does not say so.
